tools.title: Get Persons with Significant Control
tools.description: List a company's persons with significant control (beneficial owners) by company number. Explains an empty register: a market-listing exemption, a filed statement, or a genuine gap.

tools.title: Get Disqualifications
tools.description: Search the register of disqualified directors by name. No match is the ordinary result and means nothing is recorded.

ai.instructions: Use these tools to answer questions about UK companies, their officers and their ownership, using Companies House data. A company number is 8 characters — eight digits, or two letters followed by six digits, e.g. OC394454. Search by name first, then pass the returned company number or officer id to the detail tools. Companies House does not verify what companies file, so report what the register says and never present it as verification, a credit check or clearance. An officer's date of birth is published as month and year only. Ceased and resigned entries stay on the register, so check the ceased or resigned date before describing anyone as current. An absent record is a fact about the company, not a failure — say a company has no charges or no insolvency history rather than reporting an error. The disqualified directors register is searched by name and different people share names, so always carry the caveat that a name match is not proof of identity.

evals.input: @companies-house what is the company number for Monzo Bank?
@companies-house who are the current directors of company 09446231?
@companies-house find the officer id for a director called Jane Doe
@companies-house what other companies is officer i01-NvuSb_IXaHc1mrh6CAmvi48 involved in?

get-charges.note: Companies House holds no charge records for this company.

expected.meetsCriteria: Says the company has no charges on the register, and does not describe the lookup as having failed

evals.input: @companies-house who are the beneficial owners of company OC394454?
@companies-house why does company 00617987 have no people with significant control?

get-persons-with-significant-control.register_is_empty_because: The company is exempt from keeping a PSC register because its shares are admitted to trading on a regulated market.

expected.meetsCriteria: Explains the register is empty because the company is exempt, rather than saying it has no owners

evals.input: @companies-house has company 03782379 ever been in administration?

expected.meetsCriteria: Describes the insolvency case on the register

evals.input: @companies-house is there a disqualified director called Aaron Donald Smith?

matches.name: Aaron Donald SMITH
matches.reason: Unfit conduct in relation to an insolvent company

get-disqualifications.caveat: A name match is not proof of identity.

expected.meetsCriteria: Reports the match and makes clear that a name match is not proof it is the same person
